mapper.select: SELECT account_id, user_id, cash_balance, locked_cash, seed_money FROM accounts WHERE account_id = #{accountId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE accounts SET cash_balance = cash_balance + #{amount}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
UPDATE accounts SET locked_cash = locked_cash + #{amount}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
UPDATE accounts SET locked_cash = locked_cash - #{amount}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
